text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey has been in a bit of a slump 
lately. She said she wanted to go to a 
shrine, so I came along with her, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna pray with all my 
heart today and get a Copatastic luck 
boost~☆
choice_data_list:
Is praying to the gods... part of feng 
shui too?

Is praying to the gods... part of feng 
shui too?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, rather than praying for favors... 
well, of course I came for the blessings 
too, but the main reason is to give thanks 
to the gods!
choice_data_list: Are you thankful for not feeling well?
Are you thankful for not feeling well?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Fufu, close, but not quite!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course you're grateful when you're 
doing well, but when things aren't going 
well is when you should be truly thankful!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
First, express your gratitude. That way, 
the power of gratitude improves the flow 
of qi, making it easier to receive the 
gods' blessings☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Besides, expressing gratitude makes both 
the giver and the receiver happy, right? 
Giving thanks to everything around you is 
very important in feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Improve the flow of qi while enriching the 
soul at the same time. That synergy will 
open up your luck massively, making you 
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Super Happy☆!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So with that, let's go express our 
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Now that I've said my prayers properly, 
I'd love to take a little stroll around 
the shrine grounds☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Each shrine holds one of the Five 
Elements, making them power spots with 
aligned flow of qi☆ Just taking a walk 
there gives you plenty of good energy♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Phew... Feels great.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A gentle breeze, the scent of plants... It 
feels like the flow of qi inside me is 
being put in order...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, I feel like my body's gotten so 
much lighter♪ Thanks a million!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you gave lots of thanks to God on 
my behalf too, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So I just have to say thank you! Thanks 
for everything, always☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, exchanging thank-yous brings 
ultimate good fortune, doesn't it☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the two of us said thank you 
to everything we passed along the way, 
walking home in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —Hm?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! It started raining! Let's hurry 
back~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~... It's really pouring down. It took 
forever to dry my uniform, too...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still... times like this are when you 
should say thank you, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I have to believe that tidying up my inner 
environment with "Mind Feng Shui" will 
boost my fortune, even just a little...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Copano Rickey kept telling herself 
encouraging, positive words, she still 
couldn't quite get back into shape...
